coordinateSystem: Top-left pixel centers in cropped photograph; u=(x+0.5)/width, v=(y+0.5)/height. Original coordinates include the crop offset. Runtime cover mapping uses decoded derivative dimensions.

algorithm.reusedMeasurement: scripts/extract-hero-stars.py: measure_star and luminance helpers only; no old-photo masks or main
algorithm.detection: 2048px Lanczos proxy; strict 5x5 local maxima; sigma=3px local contrast

selection.method: Round-robin strongest remaining candidate by grid cell

algorithm.exclusions: Pure-sky crop excludes all terrestrial objects; no hero-source person/streak masks reused
algorithm.photometry: Measured source star centroids and sRGB samples; no arbitrary star positions
